articles.summary: There is an innate human desire for immediate causality. Software engineering is built on that feeling: write a test, find the bug, fix it, watch it pass. In the stochastic world of AI agents, that loop stops working the way it used to...
articles.title: Loss of First Principles Science with Agentic AI

articles.summary: We improved GPT-4.1-mini from 53% to 72% on τ²-bench using Lucidic's optimization algorithms, achieving performance comparable to GPT-5.2 at a fraction of the cost.
articles.title: Making GPT-4.1-mini as Good as GPT-5.2
